title: Try something new for 30 days
speaker: Matt Cutts
desc: 只有3分钟，句子短、语速慢，词汇都是常用词，适合入门第一篇

title: How to start a movement
speaker: Derek Sivers
desc: 3分钟小故事，讲得极慢极清楚，配的画面就是字幕本身，好懂

title: Every kid needs a champion
titleZh: 每个孩子都需要一个鼓励者
speaker: Rita Pierson
desc: 老师讲课，吐字清楚、句子完整，教育话题词汇不难

title: The happy secret to better work
speaker: Shawn Achor
desc: 轻松幽默，从 anecdotes 讲起，听懂故事就能跟上

title: How to speak so that people want to listen
speaker: Julian Treasure
desc: 语音专家示范发声与表达，语速中等，话题贴近生活

title: 10 ways to have a better conversation
titleZh: 好 conversation 的十条建议
speaker: Celeste Headlee
desc: 十条清单式结构，每条独立，条理清晰，适合精听跟句

title: Inside the mind of a master procrastinator
titleZh: 拖延症大师的内心世界
speaker: Tim Urban
desc: 搞笑但信息量大，有图解配合，练听力不容易走神

title: How great leaders inspire action
titleZh: 伟大领导者如何激励行动
speaker: Simon Sinek
desc: 商业演讲，长句和逻辑链多，需要跟住 because/so 的推理

title: The power of vulnerability
speaker: Brené Brown
desc: 语速快、口语化、多个人故事，词汇偏抽象情感类

title: Your body language may shape who you are
speaker: Amy Cuddy
desc: 心理学研究叙述，含实验细节词汇，语速平稳但句子长

title: The danger of a single story
speaker: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
desc: 文学化表达，长难句密集，词汇量大，适合高阶精听

title: Do schools kill creativity?
speaker: Sir Ken Robinson
desc: 英式幽默 + 即兴发挥，笑点需听懂才反应过来，难度最高
